_description: Texas UIL 6A, 2026-28 alignment. 249 schools, 32 districts. Each district plays a round-robin, then non-district games are added until every team has 10. Playoffs are the top 64 teams in 6A by wins, then point differential (top64). Prestige, facilities, and community are estimates from program reputation, not official UIL ratings.
